title: PopResume: Causal Fairness Evaluation of LLM/VLM Resume Screeners with Population-Representative Dataset
abstract: arXiv:2603.22714v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We present PopResume, a population-representative resume dataset for causal fairness auditing of LLM- and VLM-based resume screening systems. Unlike existing benchmarks that rely on manually injected demographic information and outcome-level disparities, PopResume is grounded in population statistics and preserves natural attribute relationships, enabling path-specific effect (PSE)-based fairness evaluation. We decompose the effect of a protected attribute on resume scores into two paths: the business necessity path, mediated by job-relevant qualifications, and the redlining path, mediated by demographic proxies. This distinction allows auditors to separate legally permissible from impermissible sources of disparity. Evaluating four LLMs and four VLMs on PopResume's 60.8K resumes across five occupations, we identify five representative discrimination patterns that aggregate metrics fail to capture. translated_title: PopResume：基于人群代表性数据集的大语言模型/视觉语言模型简历筛选器因果公平性评估
translated_abstract: 我们提出了PopResume，这是一个基于人群统计的代表性简历数据集，用于对基于大语言模型（LLM）和视觉语言模型（VLM）的简历筛选系统进行因果公平性审计。与现有依赖手动注入人口统计信息和结果层面差异的基准数据集不同，PopResume以人群统计数据为基础，保留了自然的属性关联，从而支持基于路径特定效应（PSE）的公平性评估。我们将受保护属性对简历评分的影响分解为两条路径：由工作相关资质介导的“商业必要性”路径，以及由人口统计代理变量介导的“红线歧视”路径。这一区分使审计人员能够区分法律上允许与不允许的评分差异来源。我们在PopResume涵盖五个职业的60.8K份简历上评估了四个LLM和四个VLM，识别出五种聚合指标无法捕捉的代表性歧视模式。我们的结果表明……
tldr: PopResume是一个基于人群统计的简历数据集，通过将受保护属性的影响分解为“商业必要性”和“红线歧视”两条路径，实现了对LLM/VLM简历筛选系统更精细的因果公平性审计，并揭示出聚合指标无法捕捉的五种歧视模式。
en_tdlr: PopResume is a population-representative resume dataset that enables causal fairness auditing of LLM/VLM resume screeners by decomposing protected attribute effects into business necessity and redlining paths, uncovering five discrimination patterns that aggregate metrics fail to capture.
